structured_output.summary: The change implements Uint8Array.prototype.toBase64 across all spec steps, in spec order. ValidateUint8Array is a TypeError on non-typed-arrays and on other typed array kinds. GetOptionsObject handles undefined, object, and other values. The alphabet is read and validated before omitPadding is read. ValidateTypedArrayBounds throws on out-of-bounds or detached arrays. The byte loop uses GetValueFromBuffer with little-endian true. The base64 and base64url tables are correct, and the padding logic is correct for 1, 2 and 3 byte chunks. Empty input gives an empty string. No test-shaped branches, no fabricated values, and no swallowed errors. The only deviations are cosmetic: the spec text in the step 9/10 comments is abbreviated with "...", and new_target is renamed to _new_target because it is now unused.
